verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's MCP docs explicitly reference dashboard creation with 'text cards and reports', and the marketing copy references delivering findings 'as a dashboard you and your team can keep working from', implying saved insights can be composed into shared dashboards. However there's no first-party documentation detailing dashboard sharing/permissions workflows or team collaboration features in depth. missing for 10: dedicated dashboard-building/sharing documentation, evidence of permission controls for team access, independent/hands-on confirmation of the dashboard composition workflow.
